name: klevAI Conector
author: klevai

sections.description:
klevAI is a marketing and customer care platform with AI for local businesses. It answers
messages, looks after reviews and books appointments, and this plugin is the part that lives
inside your WordPress site.

The plugin lets klevAI take care of the SEO fields, the structured data and the verification
tags of your posts and pages, so search engines understand them better.

Connecting takes one click. You do not copy any key by hand: WordPress creates an application
password for klevAI when you approve the connection, and you can revoke it whenever you want.

What klevAI can change

Only the actions listed in Settings → klevAI:

  • SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL, noindex and social image of posts,
    pages and WooCommerce products, written with the fields of Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One
    SEO, and directly when your site has no SEO plugin.
  • SEO title, description and noindex of categories, tags and product categories.
  • Internal links: klevAI turns text that is already in a post into a link to another page of your
    own site, so your important pages get more strength.
  • Alternative text of your images, so search engines and screen readers understand them.
  • Structured data: questions and answers, articles, navigation, services, events, restaurant
    menus, videos, how-to guides, products and many kinds of local business. On WooCommerce stores,
    klevAI completes the product data with brand, SKU, description and image.
  • Verification tags for Google Search Console and Bing, and the Google Analytics tag.
  • Google Ads conversion tag and Meta pixel, counting form submissions, calls and WhatsApp clicks
    (only if you turn them on from klevAI).
  • Contacts from your forms (Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro, Fluent Forms and
    Ninja Forms) delivered to klevAI as soon as someone sends a form (only if you turn it on).
  • A list of addresses that give a “not found” (404) error, so klevAI can redirect them to the
    right page (only if you turn it on).
  • Landing pages for your ads, published as real pages of your site with a full-screen template.
  • 301 and 302 redirects, hreflang links between pages in different languages (also next to
    Polylang and WPML), and IndexNow notifications when you publish (only if you turn it on).
  • Elementor Pro header and footer display conditions, so each page shows them in its own
    language.
  • The klevAI chat on your site, without copying any code. It switches on by itself when you connect your site, if your klevAI plan includes it.
  • Blog posts: klevAI writes and publishes them for you (title, text, featured image, category, tags, scheduled date and SEO fields), and can update them later. Every post can be undone.
  • Speed switches: image priority, lazy images, scripts that do not block the page, and the removal of emojis, embeds and jQuery Migrate (all optional).
  • Cookie consent for Google and Meta tags (Google Consent Mode v2): off by default; you can use a simple built-in notice or your own cookie plugin.
  • robots.txt rules and an llms.txt file for AI search engines.
  • A read-only SEO health report: versions, SEO plugin, sitemap, pages without title or
    description, images without alternative text and broken internal links.
  • Read-only lists for klevAI: unused images and images without alternative text, your menus and
    site settings, duplicate titles and descriptions, and chains of redirects.

After each change, the plugin clears the cache of WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache,
WP Super Cache, WP Fastest Cache, SiteGround Optimizer and others, so you see it straight away.

See what klevAI has done

Settings → klevAI and a box in your WordPress Dashboard show how many improvements klevAI has made
in the last 30 days.

Every change can be undone

Every change is saved in a change log inside Settings → klevAI, with its date and the value
that was there before. If you do not like a change, press Undo and the previous value comes
back.

What the plugin never does

The plugin never runs code sent from outside, never edits files of your theme or your plugins,
and never installs anything on your site. It comes in English and Spanish.

To connect the plugin you need a klevAI account.

External services

klevAI

Service: klevAI (https://landing.klevai.es/).

The plugin itself does not contact any server on its own, except for the form contacts
described below, and only if you turn them on.

When you click «Connect with klevAI», your browser opens app.klevai.es with your site address
so you can log in and approve the connection. WordPress then creates an application password
for klevAI and sends it to app.klevai.es; you can revoke it at any time.

With that password, klevAI calls your site’s REST API to read your posts, pages and their SEO
fields, the WordPress and plugin versions, and to apply the actions listed in Settings →
klevAI. This only happens while the site is connected.

Landing pages

Landing pages that klevAI publishes on your site send what a visitor writes in their form to
klevAI (https://<your-page>.klevai.site/enviar), so your business receives the request. The page
also tells klevAI when it is visited and when a button is clicked, so you can see how your ads
perform. No cookies are set and nothing is stored in the visitor’s browser.

Form contacts

Only if you turn it on from klevAI, when a visitor sends a form on your site (Contact Form 7,
WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro, Fluent Forms or Ninja Forms), the plugin sends what they
wrote (name, phone, email, message and the other fields of the form, the form name and the page)
to klevAI (https://app.klevai.es/l/…) so your business can answer them. Passwords, card numbers
and files are never sent. A copy is kept on your site for 30 days and then deleted. The visitor’s
IP address and browser are never stored.

Google Ads and Meta

Only if you turn them on from klevAI, the plugin loads the Google tag
(https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js) with your Google Ads conversion ID and the Meta pixel
(https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js) on the public pages of your site, and tells them
when a form is sent or a phone or WhatsApp link is clicked. Google terms:
https://policies.google.com/terms · Google privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy ·
Meta terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms · Meta privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy

Cookie consent notice

If you choose the built-in notice, a small banner asks your visitors whether they accept
measurement and advertising cookies. The answer is saved in the visitor’s browser (localStorage) and
passed to Google and Meta tags. Nothing is sent to klevAI.

Featured images of blog posts

When klevAI publishes a post with an image address, the plugin downloads that image (https only)
and adds it to your media library.

klevAI chat

If you turn on the chat from klevAI, the plugin loads the chat script from
https://app.klevai.es/w/chat/… on the public pages of your site. What visitors write in the chat
is sent to klevAI so it can answer them.

IndexNow

Only if you turn it on from klevAI, the plugin tells search engines that support IndexNow
(Bing, Yandex and others) about pages you publish or update, by sending their addresses to
https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow. IndexNow terms: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

Terms of use: https://landing.klevai.es/?p=condiciones
Privacy policy: https://landing.klevai.es/?p=privacidad
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for «klevAI».
  2. Press «Install Now» and then «Activate».
  3. Open Settings → klevAI and press «Connect with klevAI».
  4. A WordPress screen asks you to approve the connection. Press «Yes, I approve».
sections.faq:
Do I need a klevAI account?

Yes. The plugin works together with klevAI, so you need an account to connect the site.

What can klevAI change on my site?

Only the actions listed in Settings → klevAI. Nothing else, and every change can be undone.

Can I undo a change?

Yes. Every change appears in the log with an Undo button that restores the previous value.

How do I disconnect?

Press the Disconnect button in Settings → klevAI, or delete the application password named
«klevAI» in Users → Profile.

Does it work without an SEO plugin?

Yes. If you use Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO the plugin writes in their fields; if
you have none, it prints the title, the description, the canonical, the robots tag and the
Open Graph data itself.
sections.changelog:
1.7.0

  • The klevAI chat and the form contacts switch on by themselves when you connect your site, if your plan includes them. If it does not include the chat, Settings → klevAI tells you how to add it.
  • After you activate the plugin you land on Settings → klevAI to connect.
  • Blog posts: klevAI can create and update posts with their featured image, category, tags, scheduled date and SEO fields (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or none), with undo.
  • Speed switches: turn on scripts without blocking and remove emojis, embeds and jQuery Migrate.
  • Cookie consent for Google and Meta tags (Google Consent Mode v2), off by default.
  • New read-only lists: unused images, images without alternative text, menus and site settings, duplicate titles and descriptions, chains of redirects.

1.6.0

  • klevAI can now read the list of your published posts (address, title, dates and word count), page by page and read-only, to plan which ones to improve.

1.5.0

  • Faster pages: the main image of each page loads first, and the other images load only when the visitor reaches them.
  • Option to load scripts without blocking the page (off by default).

1.4.0

  • The plugin is now in Spanish.
  • SEO and product structured data for WooCommerce products, and SEO for categories and tags.
  • Internal links inside posts, with undo.
  • Contacts from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro, Fluent Forms and Ninja Forms
    delivered to klevAI.
  • Google Ads conversion tag and Meta pixel.
  • List of “not found” (404) addresses so klevAI can redirect them.
  • More structured data: services, events, menus, videos, how-to guides, products and local
    business types.
  • The cache is cleared after each change.
  • Settings → klevAI and the Dashboard show what klevAI has done in the last 30 days.
  • Fixed: image descriptions could not be saved.
  • Fixed: questions and answers, navigation and other structured data with lists were saved empty.

1.3.0

  • klevAI can add the Google Analytics tag to your site (skipped if Site Kit already adds the same one), with undo.

1.2.0

  • klevAI can fix your robots.txt and publish an llms.txt, with undo.

1.1.0

  • Landing pages published as real WordPress pages, with their own full-screen template.
  • Redirects, hreflang and IndexNow.
  • Elementor Pro header and footer conditions per language.
  • klevAI chat without copying code.
  • Read-only SEO health report.

1.0.0

  • One-click connection with klevAI, using a WordPress application password.
  • SEO actions: title, description, focus keyword, canonical, noindex and social image.
  • Structured data for questions, articles, navigation and local businesses.
  • Verification tags for Google Search Console and Bing.
  • Change log with Undo.
  • Removed the manual connection code and the site proxy; they will come back as WordPress
    pages in a future version.

0.2.0

  • klevAI blog articles: title and description for Google and frequently asked questions in the search results.

0.1.0

  • First version: connection with klevAI, routes and form.
